## Why

I have selected a single, ornate, cylindrical metal vessel, representative of a ciborium or a large oil stock. This choice relates directly to the core themes of *Quo fluctu*, which grants unusual permissions to clergy in revolutionary France to protect and administer the sacraments. In a time when traditional worship was forbidden, the vessel—used to hold the Eucharist or holy oils—symbolizes the continuity and provisional survival of sacramental grace. By choosing this concrete liturgical object rather than an abstract form, I fulfill the requirement for immediate recognizability. The vessel stands alone as a singular subject, embodies the spiritual emergency described by Pius VI, and can be rendered as a high-quality 3D object on a transparent background, ensuring its legibility and symbolic fit.
